resources.string: Paste nodes, test rules, and start the IPv4 and IPv6 tunnel when ready.

This preview routes IPv4 and IPv6 while connected. Enter a trusted DNS address. For a TCP-only node, the DNS server must accept TCP on port 53. Node hostnames may still need system DNS to connect. Stopping or losing the VPN restores normal networking. With domain rules configured, Rule mode matches visible HTTP or TLS names on supported ports.
